title: Rdash vs SiteFlow | Which Construction App is Right for You?
metaTitle: Rdash vs SiteFlow | Which Construction App is Right for You?
metaDescription: Compare Rdash vs SiteFlow on BOQ execution control, face recognition attendance, design management, and Tally integration to choose the right platform.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: RDash unifies design workflows, procurement, and financial monitoring across stakeholders, with strength in design-build and fit-out projects. SiteFlow is built execution-first, connecting BOQ, labour attendance, materials, and billing into live cost control at the point of work. SiteFlow enforces financial discipline at commitment; RDash surfaces insights through monitoring dashboards and an AI Copilot layer.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs RDash: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: RDash unifies design, procurement, and finance with an AI Copilot for visibility. SiteFlow connects BOQ, labour, materials, and billing into live cost control at the point of work.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between SiteFlow and RDash?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is built around BOQ-driven execution control where every site activity connects to cost and P&L in real time. RDash unifies design, procurement, and finance with strength in design-build and fit-out, surfacing insights through dashboards and an AI Copilot layer.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow have an AI Copilot like RDash?
faqs.a: SiteFlow does not position a prompt-based AI Copilot as a primary feature. It focuses on real-time cost visibility, automated reports, and execution dashboards built from verified site data, while RDash's AI Copilot enables prompt-based analytics and margin leakage detection.

faqs.q: How does labour tracking differ between the two?
faqs.a: SiteFlow verifies workers through face recognition and GPS before any attendance record is created, making proxy and ghost workers structurally impossible. RDash tracks crew activity against planned timelines with workforce visibility, but face recognition is not publicly highlighted.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow integrate with Tally for accounting?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow has native two-way integration with Tally ERP and Zoho Books, syncing purchase orders, vendor invoices, subcontractor bills, and client receipts automatically so accounts stay on Tally without double entry. RDash positions compatibility with external ERP, though Tally specifics are not prominently documented.
